metadata.title: Add pagination for tools in servers page
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# ✨ Feature / Enhancement PR

## 🔗 Epic / Issue
Works on #1224

---

## 🚀 Summary (1-2 sentences)
- Implements **pagination** for Associated Tools list in Servers page using the same backend API as Tools page
- Implements **Select All** for Associated Tools independent of how many tools are loaded in DOM using a new API in admin.py
- Implements **Search** for Associated Tools independent of how many tools are loaded in DOM using a new API in admin.py
- Implements **pagination** for Selected Tools in Edit Server screen
- Correctly **auto selects** Associated Tools in Add Server and Edit Server screens even when the pages are loading with HTMX
- Adds selected prompt and selected resource **pills** in Add Server screen
- Makes the **pill formatting** consistent between Add Server and Edit Server screens
- Implements logic to display more than 3 tools/prompts/resources as **+N more**
---

## 🧪 Checks

- [x] `make lint` passes
- [x] `make test` passes
- [x] Tested with 10k tools (pagination works at 100k tools too, but server creation is failing)
